rationale: The Court is likely to hold that § 3702 supplies the governmentwide presentment/settlement/finality and six-year time-bar rules for CRSC underpayment claims because § 1413a lacks the clear procedural markers needed to displace the Barring Act. A lone Sotomayor dissent is the most probable separate writing, emphasizing § 1413a’s remedial, agency-administered scheme and the inequity of importing § 3702’s bar.
